articles.mainIdea: Boeing Rival Airbus’ Stock Drops After Earnings Beat. This Is The Big Problem.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Boeing Rival Airbus’ Stock Drops After Earnings Beat. This Is The Big Problem.. Shares of Boeing peer Airbus were down 7% in overseas trading on Thursday after the company reported better-than-expected fourth-quarter earnings. For 2026, however, Airbus expects to make 870 jets and generate an operating profit of about €7.5 billion ($8.8 billion). Wall Street was looking for closer to 900 jets and €8.2 billion in operating profit. Related tickers mentioned: AIR, BA, EADSF, ^DJI, ^GSPC.
